about_the_game:
Miniature Shop Simulator: Prologue is a free version that lets you try out the gameplay of Miniature Shop Simulator ahead of release. This version includes limited content and allows you to experience the core gameplay mechanics.

Miniature Shop Simulator is a detailed simulation game where you take on the role of a miniature shop owner. Your goal is to create the ultimate place for hobby enthusiasts, from selling sets, to painting and collecting miniatures, all the way to growing your entire business.

🎨 Painting & Collecting
One of the game’s core features is painting miniatures. Use different paints, techniques, and tools to give each figure a unique look. Build your own collections and proudly display them in your shop to inspire visitors and attract collectors.

🛍️ Shop Management
Buy and sell miniature sets, restock your shelves, and set prices. Make sure customers find what they’re looking for and keep them coming back. Follow market trends to bring in the most popular sets and attract new hobbyists.

🎍 Expansion & Customization
Over time, expand your shop by adding more space, changing the layout, and decorating the interior. Your choices will shape how customers perceive your store and how eager they are to return.

Key Features:

  • Paint miniatures and build unique collections 🎨

  • Buy and sell sets for both customers and collectors 🛍️

  • Customize and decorate your shop 🎍

  • Track trends and adjust your offers 📈

  • Grow your business step by step, from a small store to a true hobby hub 💰

Can you build the store that becomes legendary among miniature fans?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows (64-bit) 10
  • Processor: i5 3550 / RYZEN 5 2500X
  • Memory: 4 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 / AMD R9 270X
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows (64-bit) 10
  • Processor: i5 7600K / Ryzen 5 2600x
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 / AMD RX 480
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
